# WO-416: Message catalog: move the finding code's sentences out of the logic
Status: blocked: needs in-house message-catalog module and a language setting first
Vendor: codex
Agent: engine-tests (Ravi Menon)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Kind: engine
Epic: E10 (docs/vendor/EPICS.md)
Target release: 0.4
Source: in-house 0.4 epic batch 2026-11-09 (in-house offline until about Nov 14; vendors keep working the queue in epic order)
Worktree: none until unblocked (then `.vendor-wt/wo-416` on `vendor/wo-416` from main)
Tracker: issue pending (in-house syncs freemyid-pm)
Order: start only after WO-403, WO-299, WO-415 are merged (they share a file or a behaviour this builds on); rebase on main first.

## Goal
Today the sentences are Python literals inside logic, some with the band word spliced in (`Your exposure is {b} ...`, `engine/exposure_score.py:210-213`) and English-only plural helpers (`_n`, `exposure_models.py:94-95`; `_plural`, `exposure_score.py:66-68`). Replace them with catalog lookups so a Spanish catalog can be added later without touching logic. With the language at English every output is byte-identical to today.

## Blocked: what in-house must provide first
In-house must (1) choose the mechanism and add the module (for example `src/freemyid/messages.py` with `t(key, **params)` and an English catalog file under `src/freemyid/` or `locales/`), including plural handling that does not rely on English "one/many" pairs (Spanish and later Vietnamese, Tagalog and Chinese differ), (2) add a language setting to `config.py` (default English, so nothing changes today) and the wizard and CLI wiring, (3) tell Codex the key naming scheme and that `HAND_REASONS` and `STATUS_TEXT` keep their dict shapes for existing readers (`--json` output must not change when the language is English). Then Codex replaces the literal sentences in the three modules with catalog lookups, key by key, and keeps `docs/i18n/STRINGS_BACKEND.md` (WO-415) in step.

Not startable by a vendor. In-house unblocks it by changing the status line and posting a GO.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For each of `exposure_models`, `exposure_score`, `search_engines`: output with the English catalog equals the stored golden output captured from main before the change (every `HAND_REASONS` value, `coverage_note` and `headline` for the cases in `tests/test_exposure_coverage.py`, every `STATUS_TEXT` value).
2. No user-facing English literal remains in those three modules outside the catalog (a test lists string literals longer than 30 characters in them and allows only an explicit allow-list of developer-only strings).
3. A test catalog in another language (a tiny fake in the test) changes the output of every message with no code path left in English, including the band words and the plural forms.
4. The plural rule is data in the catalog, not an `if n == 1` in code, for every message with a count.
5. `--json` documents and stored events (the `reason` code, not the sentence) are unchanged; existing tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
